method.candidate_binding: SHA256(canonical JSON of binding schema + target profile schema + collector version + requirement id + only explicitly required fact records)
method.important_limit: Requirement dependency sets are hypotheses; this experiment proves deterministic invalidation mechanics under those sets, not semantic completeness of the sets.

aggregate_result.interpretation: The monolithic WP1201 digest invalidates every dependent consumer on every represented fact change. A requirement-scoped digest can avoid all irrelevant invalidation by construction while preserving all declared relevant changes, but only if the dependency declaration is semantically complete.

negative_result.reason: WP1201 G1 has no boot-scope identity/fact. A reboot with otherwise identical collected facts has no explicit schema-level discriminator, so neither monolithic nor requirement-scoped fact binding can prove boot continuity/change.

external_primary_evidence.finding: systemd distinguishes machine, application-specific machine, boot, application-specific boot, and invocation IDs; boot ID changes per running kernel instance and application-specific derivation is recommended when exporting identity to untrusted contexts.
boot_id is a UUID generated for the boot and stable after retrieval during that boot.
system extension compatibility is matched on a requirement-like subset (ID plus SYSEXT_LEVEL or VERSION_ID, and architecture if declared), not a digest of unrelated host state.

wpctl status reports current PipeWire objects/devices/sinks/sources/filters/streams and runtime-resolved object IDs; this supports treating raw topology as a volatile runtime witness rather than a stable host identity component.

counterhypotheses: The monolithic digest is intentionally conservative and may be safer if dependency maps are incomplete.
Requirement-scoped binding can create false preservation if any required field is omitted or if a hidden cross-field dependency exists.
The apparent invalidation reduction is structurally guaranteed by declared subsets and therefore does not by itself prove operational benefit; real F2 workload dependency tests are required.

Adding separate HostScopeIdentity and BootScopeIdentity may be unnecessary for consumers that never reason across boots; the IDs should be introduced only where a consumer contract needs those scopes.
architecture_delta_candidate: Preserve WP1201 whole-profile digest as provenance. Add typed profile components and explicit requirement dependency declarations; derive requirement binding digests from only required components. Add application-specific host identity and separate boot-scope identity only for consumers that need those scopes. Move PipeWire topology and similarly volatile outputs to runtime-witness scope. UNKNOWN remains explicit and should invalidate only requirements that depend on that unknown field.
next_exact_gate: Create an E5 build-candidate packet only if it requires Trigger-4 to implement a minimal deterministic successor/adapter with dependency-completeness tests. Trigger-4 acceptance must include negative tests where one omitted relevant dependency causes a forced failure, plus a reboot-scope test once BootScopeIdentity exists.
